I saved the Q3 answers to `/work/answer.json`. I haven't checked them against your Q2 reference values, so they're unconfirmed.

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| a. Top segment by net sales | SMB, 294,298,343원 |
| b. Customers with a paid order | 298 |
| c. Top category by net sales | sw, 312,975,721원 |
| d. Month with the highest net sales | 2025-07 (310,619,974원) |
| e. Customer with the largest total refunds | u143@ex.com (1,651,415원) |
| f. Customers with 2+ paid orders | 277 |
| g. Average net sales per order | 678,120원 |
| h. September vs. August growth | 15.4% (August 233,620,822원 → September 269,503,882원) |

How I treated the data:
- **Segment names:** the same segment is spelled several ways (`SMB`/`smb`, `Enterprise `, ` consumer`). I trimmed spaces and ignored case so each spelling counts as one segment. I wrote the answer as "SMB", but the reference writes segments in lowercase ("consumer"), so it may need to be "smb".
- **Date range:** order times are in UTC (ending in `Z`). I used them as they are, from `2025-07-01` up to but not including `2025-10-01`. I didn't convert to Korean time (KST); if the quarter should be in KST, the answers will change.
- **Refunds:** each refund row matches a product line in its order, and no refund quantity is larger than the quantity ordered.

**Why this isn't verified:** the project's CLAUDE.md says not to check results by running them again or comparing them with reference values. So I didn't recalculate Q2 to see whether it reproduces your reference numbers. That means I haven't confirmed that the segment spelling and timezone choices above are right.

STATUS: PARTIAL
